remarks: Enjoy the advantages of condo living in Swallow Creek. This well-maintained community is set back from the main road and winds through mature trees and landscaped areas creating a peaceful setting in all seasons.  The interior floor plan was designed with convenience in mind.. Enter the living room and note the generous natural light afforded by the recently replaced high quality windows and sliding glass door.  The unique location of this unit provides a view of the surrounding open space.  An adjoining deck is a nice addition for outdoor relaxation.  The fireplace has been converted to gas for further comfort and convenience.  A modern kitchen renovation reveals pleasing gray cabinetry, new lighting and solid surface countertops.  Note the sun tube providing natural light all day.  All appliances are included.  The kitchen leads to the convenient laundry area. Garage has epoxy-type flooring and an entry platform custom-designed for safety.  Two bedrooms and two full baths provide privacy.  A complete description of the bathroom renovations is included in the attached improvement list.  Start the day with a short walk to the historic Four Corners for your morning coffee.  Enjoy more restaurants, shopping and community events.  Leave the demands of home maintenance behind and experience the easy lifestyle at Swallow Creek!  Pets are allowed with Board Approval.  Also listed as a condo under B1721191.
